subject: general
question:
Choose the appropriate option to complete the given sentence:

I got late for the flight ______ there was so much of traffic on the road.
solution:
The correct answer is **because**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "because" introduces a reason or cause for the preceding statement.
 
• In this sentence, "because" explains **why** the person got late for the flight – due to heavy traffic.
 
• The other options do not logically connect the two parts of the sentence to indicate a cause-and-effect relationship.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Complete Sentence:** I got late for the flight **because** there was so much of traffic on the road.
